item.title: Oracle Java SE SecurityManager Sandbox Escape (CVE-2012-4681)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 10) — binary · CVE-2012-4681. Status: PoC (sandbox-escape primitive implemented; demonstration program only, no applet delivery or second-stage payload). Affects: Oracle Java SE (JRE and JDK): java.beans, com.sun.beans.finder.ClassFinder and sun.awt.SunToolkit. Tags: Java, JRE, sandbox escape, SecurityManager, reflection, applet, ClassFinder, SunToolkit, CWE-284, CISA KEV.
